leah: Quick note — noticed two issues in the runtime quickstart: the curl example returns a 404 for the /v1/ping endpoint, and the codeblock uses an old base URL (api.redwood.dev).

miguel: ah, the backend moved that endpoint to /v2/health as part of the telemetry cleanup. Which page is this on?

leah: /handbook/runtime/quickstart.html near the top. snippet:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/ping
```
should be:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v2/health
```

jin: I can pick this up. plan: update the snippet, add an inline note about versioned endpoints, and create a tiny CI smokecheck that curls the page and verifies the example 200s.

leah: also tagging @docs-owners — we need an owner assigned to that quickstart. it's currently listed as "tbd" in frontmatter. can someone volunteer?

docs-owners: @platform-team volunteer: miguel.

miguel: I'll own the page and cover the pratfall for customers migrating to v2. will also coordinate with infra to keep a compatibility redirect for /v1/ping -> /v2/health for 30 days.

ci-bot: CI run queued for docs PR by jin at 2024-09-02T09:15:00Z  docs-build #2145

jin: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1175 — changes: update curl examples, set owner to @miguel, add CI smokecheck step.

ci-bot: docs-build #2145 passed at 2024-09-02T09:18:10Z  smokecheck OK (curl example validated)

leah: thanks. miguel please confirm redirect plan (30d 302 or 301?). we prefer temporary 302 while we monitor traffic and then convert to 301 if no regressions.

miguel: agreed. will ask infra to add a 302 for 30d then re-evaluate. I'll also add a quick faq note on migration steps.

jin: merging after CI green and docs-owners ack. leaving a small changelog entry under "Docs: quickstart runtime curl update".

leah: small follow-up: can we also update the curl example to use --fail so CI catches non-2xx in the future? tiny PR ok if no objections.

miguel: please do. low-risk.

leah: awesome, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
